import pytest

from eventbus import EventBus, Recorder


def test_publish_reaches_subscribers():
    bus, rec = EventBus(), Recorder()
    bus.subscribe("orders.created", rec)
    assert bus.publish("orders.created", {"id": 1}) == 1
    assert rec.events == [{"id": 1}]


def test_other_topics_are_ignored():
    bus, rec = EventBus(), Recorder()
    bus.subscribe("orders.created", rec)
    assert bus.publish("orders.cancelled", {"id": 2}) == 0
    assert rec.events == []


def test_unsubscribe():
    bus, rec = EventBus(), Recorder()
    token = bus.subscribe("jobs.done", rec)
    bus.unsubscribe(token)
    bus.publish("jobs.done", "x")
    assert rec.events == []


def test_failing_handler_does_not_stop_others():
    bus, rec = EventBus(), Recorder()
    bus.subscribe("jobs.done", lambda event: 1 / 0)
    bus.subscribe("jobs.done", rec)
    bus.publish("jobs.done", "x")
    assert rec.events == ["x"]
